fields.System.Title: Login Screen
fields.System.Description:
As a registered user, log in with email and password to access the account.

Background: The user is on the login page.

Scenario: Successful login with valid credentials
Expected result: Authenticated and redirected to the dashboard / home page

Scenario: Empty email field
Expected result: Login button stays disabled or inactive

Scenario: Empty password field
Expected result: Login button stays disabled or inactive

Scenario: Invalid email format (example user@domain)
Expected result: Inline validation error; user stays on the login page

Scenario: Unregistered email, or valid email with the wrong password
Expected result: Invalid-credentials error; user stays on the page; password field is cleared

Scenario: Show / Hide on the password field
Expected result: Plain text, then masked again

Scenario: Forgot Password?
Expected result: Redirect to the password recovery page

Scenario: Either required field empty
Expected result: Login button stays disabled or inactive
